# See cash at closing — and whether the higher offer actually pays more.

> Free seller net sheet: see cash at closing after listing commission, optional buyer-broker compensation, concessions, title, and payoff. Compare two offers — the higher price is not always more cash.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
